other_conditions: Applicant must be the nominee, dependent, or legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
The deceased worker must be a registered building and other construction worker with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The death must be due to natural causes.
benefits_summary: A relief amount of ₹1,00,000 is provided to the nominee, dependents, or legal heirs of a deceased construction worker.
